overview_description.description: Field AI develops autonomy software that equips mobile robots with a universal, risk-aware brain. It offers Field Foundation Models™ (FFMs) that enable embodiment-agnostic operation across humanoid, legged, wheeled, flying, and tracked platforms. The company’s technology empowers robots to work safely in dynamic, unmapped environments, without reliance on GPS, pre-programmed routes, or maps, operating fully at the edge in real-time. Robots using this software can be deployed across industries such as construction, energy, mining, agriculture, urban operations, manufacturing, power and utilities, and federal applications, among others.
